markers.description: put the blocks (from left to right) to: pickaxe/oilcan/stethoscope/drill

Astronaut, Rex Fury
Open the orange-handled box, revealing an Astro Crate. Activate the crate to create a switch, disable the laser beams.

Farmer
In the last area, just before the end: Use a blue jump pad to hop to a ledge above the cabin containing Stinky Fletcher's recording. To the left is a wooden platform with a Chicken Glide activity. Use this to traverse the canyon. On the far side is a section resembling a Donkey Kong arcade level. The red brick is at the top.

markers.title: Data Scan Upgrade - City Challenges
markers.description:
Robber
On the second level of the police station, in a jail cell that needs a crowbar to open.

Allows the Data Scanner to show locations for Disguise Booths, Free Runs, Super Builds, Time Trials, and Train Stations.

markers.title: Data Scan Upgrade - Character Challenges
markers.description:
No requirements
Smash the green garbage can, revealing a Detective Point. Follow it to a pile of leaves.

Allows the Data Scanner to show Character Challenges, which are spots such as this Detective Point, Drill Thrills, Pigs, ATMs, etc.

markers.title: Data Scan Upgrade - Red Bricks
markers.description:
No requirements
At the eastern pillar of the southern bridge support, break a blue barrel to build a jumping platform. Use it to reach a stud wall to climb up to the platform above. Run around the support beam to find a high-wire line. Carefully walk out on the line until you reach the middle.

Allows the Data Scanner to show the locations of other Red Bricks.

markers.title: Data Scan Upgrade - Tokens
markers.description:
Miner
Get some dynamite at the vending machine at the gas station. You can use it on some boulders northeast of the station. This reveals a cave, inside of which is a pile of boulders. Smash them to get this red brick.

Allows the scanner to show locations for (visible) character tokens - it will not show tokens that require previous actions to appear.

markers.title: Data Scan Upgrade - Clues
markers.description:
Miner
Get some dynamite from the structure to the north of the clearing. Blow up the silver crate on the south side of the clearing.

Allows the Data Scanner to show Detective Points, as well as colorable objects that unlock things.

No requirements
Central Support, East side: At water level, look for a climbable ramp. Use of a boat is recommended.

Enables turbo boost for almost all land vehicles.

Astronaut, Robber (and Farmer to get the right color)
Requires Green in the Color Gun, which can be obtained at the Art Museum; second from the back on the left.
Back at the Toy Store, paint both red buttons green. Climb up and find two elevator platforms. Hop on either one, and when it gets to the top, proceed left to a teleporter. Use this to go behind the signage, and simply jump to get the red brick.

Rex Fury
Open the door to get into this hangar.

markers.title: Super Ram
markers.description:
No requirements
In an alcove below the main ground level. Easiest to find by jumping in the water.

Ramming other vehicles with this enabled often sends them flying.

markers.title: Ringtone - Gas
markers.description:
Farmer
On the roof of the Herbert Hotel. The route to this follows the route taken during Chapter 11 - The Proof of the Pudding is in the Meeting.

markers.title: Super Drill Ride
markers.description:
Rex Fury

Makes the riding speed of the Pneumatic Drill faster.

No requirements
Use the button panel at the bottom of the Plaza Building to gain access to the top floor. Head left around the glass hallway.

Allows you to instantly summon any unlocked ground vehicle from a menu.

markers.title: Super Axe Smash
markers.description:
Astronaut
Use a helicopter to get to the top of the north west tower of this building. From there, use the Astronaut's Super Rocket Boost to get across to the southwest tower, then the jumping platform to the southeast tower, then a tightrope to the northeast tower.

Makes bashing down doors with the fireman much faster.

markers.title: Ringtone - Pig
markers.description:
Robber
In a boat, enter the Grand Canal from Pagoda and take the first right. Midway, you'll see a dock on the side with a locked door. Pry it open.

markers.title: Fall Rescue
markers.description:
Astronaut, Farmer
Grow a nearby plant to get onto the awnings, then head left to a blue pipe (or use the Astronaut's jetpack). Climb up, then head to the greenhouse and use the teleporter to get inside.

Rex Fury
From the playground in the center of this block, climb to the rooftops until you reach the Jenny's Diner sign. Climb up the blue pole there, then pull the orange handle.

Construction Worker, Robber
The plaza east of here has a drill point on the northwest corner. Use the Pneumatic Drill on it, then boost up to a ledge. Follow it to the left and pry open a locked door.

Changes the sound of the police whistle.

Farmer
On the eastern edge of this building is a fenced-in area. Smash the blue barrel inside, build a trampoline out of it and jump up. Go left or right and vault through the obstacles. On the west side of the building is a plant. Water it and climb up. Go right to find a blue pipe and continue up. Again, go left or right and vault. Again on the east side, build another trampoline and jump up. When you can't climb any further, go back to the west side of the building. Above where you can reach, you'll see 3 hopping platforms that lead to a bulkhead or roof access structure. The red brick is hidden behind this structure.

Construction Worker

Find the drill spot on the outside ledge of the center bridge support column. Launch up from the water jet, then slowly work your way around the bridge support until you reach the top, free run across the ledges to the opposite side then glide down the rope.

markers.title: Super Ray Gun
markers.description:
No requirements
Take a boat around to the back of Apollo Island. You'll find a smaller island with a missile silo. Trigger all the switches to open it, then jump down into the hole.

Increases the ray gun's damage.

markers.title: Police Siren Hat
markers.description:
Robber, Astronaut.
From the beach, teleport into the prison yard and head over to the tall guard tower. Here, you'll need to pry open a locked door.

markers.title: Wii U only: Mario Hat
markers.description:
Astronaut, Fireman
On the island, climb the tall flag pole then slide over to the base of the statue. Slowly work your way around to the Teleport pad, traveling up to the top of the statue. Put out the fire then slide down from the torch top

markers.title: Capture Alien (Cherry Tree Hills)
markers.description: No requirements

markers.title: Capture Alien (Festival Square)
markers.description:
No requirements
Use the grappling hook point on the south side of the Hospital.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Kings Court)
markers.description:
Jetpack
North of the ferry is a small building. Around back is a climbing wall. The Astro Crate is on the roof of this building.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Downtown)
markers.description:
Farmer, Robber, Jetpack
On the northeast side of this building is a vine. Grow it with the Farmer, and climb up to the roof. Head to the southeast side of the roof and find a skylight that can be pried open with the Robber. Jump in and use the teleport pad to get to the very top of this building, where the Astro Crate is.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Crescent Park)
markers.description:
No requirements
Behind the waterfall.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Lego City Airport)
markers.description:
Fireman
Bash through the Fireman door to get into Hangar 03.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Uptown)
markers.description:
No requirements.
Atop the Wheatley's Bakery building.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Fort Meadows)
markers.description:
Miner
Blow up the silver boulders across the highway from the gas station. Inside the cave, find the Astro Crate to the north of the entrance.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Bluebell National Park)
markers.description:
Jetpack
Climb the stair-step-looking mountain. The Astro Crate is at the top.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Apollo Island)
markers.description:
Jetpack, Farmer
On the north side of the Mission Control building is a blue climbing pad. Use the jetpack to get to the pad and climb up. Use the vaulting pole to get across, where you'll find a plant. Use the farmer to grow it, then climb it. Slide across the gap to the Vehicle Assemly Building. Wall-run around the corner, then wall-run two more times. You will now be holding on to a blue and gray pipe. Shimmy right, then wall-run two more times. Climb up on the right side, wall-run back to the left, climb up the wall, climb up the ramp, jump on the trampoline to get to another climbing wall. Finally, on the roof of the VAB, go left or right to the north side of the building to find the Astro Crate. Bear in mind that the alien will appear at ground level; there is a Drill Thrill activity, a District Conquered marker, and a Super Build (Helipad) up here.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Albatross Island)
markers.description:
No requirements
From the entrance to the prison yard, go past the enclosed basketball court and head left Climb the wall and get into the fenced-in area. Use the catapult to get across. The Astro Crate is to the right.

A jetpack can make this a little shorter. From the prison yard entrance, go south and a little west to find a tall fence. Jet over it, then jet up onto the building to your left.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Auburn)
markers.description:
No requirements
Under the ramp.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Lady Liberty Island)
markers.description:
Rex Fury, Astronaut
Rex Fury and the Astronaut disguise must be unlocked in order to get to Lady Liberty Island.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Paradise Sands)
markers.description:
Farmer (or Jetpack)
On the roof of the Herbert Hotel. The route to this follows the route taken during Chapter 11 - The Proof of the Pudding is in the Meeting. The jetpack can be used to skip climbing the Honey Hotel; hop onto a blue port-a-potty south of the building that is northeast of the Honey Hotel. From there, hop onto the building itself and continue on the route.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Fresco)
markers.description:
Farmer (or Jetpack)
Grow a nearby plant to get onto the awnings, then head left to a blue pipe (or use the Astronaut's jetpack). Climb up, then head left. Vault over three walls to find the Astro Crate.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Bright Lights Plaza)
markers.description:
Jetpack
Inside the gym. Jetpack from the Bus Stop south of the Toy Store to the awning that goes around the Toy Store. Head left and circle around to the back of the building. After the tightrope, continue north. You'll be behind a railing with lights on it. At the north end of this railing is a Jetpack Activity. Follow it to land on one of the awnings of the Theater. Circle around to the east side of the building, using tightropes and vaulting poles, until it bends south. Use the teleporter pad to get into the gym. Once the alien is escaping, use the teleporter pad again to get back out.

markers.title: Capture Alien (Pagoda)
markers.description:
No requirements
Climb up the blue pipes next to Aiden's. Once on the roof, go across the bridge.

markers.title: Silver Statue (King's Court)
markers.description:
Farmer
On the west side of the capitol building, grow a vine to climb up. Proceed along the south side of the building, circling around to the east side. Grow another vine here and climb up to the roof. Use the short ladder here to get up the vaulted part of the roof, then head west to the statue.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Downtown)
markers.description: No requirements

markers.title: Silver Statue (Crescent Park)
markers.description:
Astronaut
Use the teleporter pad at the base of the gazebo.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Lego City Airport)
markers.description: No requirements

markers.title: Silver Statue (Uptown)
markers.description:
Astronaut, Jetpack
In front of the museum.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Fort Meadows)
markers.description:
Farmer
Chicken Glide from the top of one of the cabins north of the train station.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Bluebell National Park)
markers.description:
No requirements
Climb the rocks on the east side of the clearing. There's an office with some incomplete concrete pilings to the left of where you'll want to start.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Apollo Island)
markers.description:
Astronaut, Jetpack
On the north side of the control building is a blue climbing pad. Use the jetpack to get to the pad and climb up. The statue is to the right as you get to the top.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Albatross Island)
markers.description:
Astronaut, Farmer or Jetpack, Robber
In the rear prison yard, get to sloped roof on the southwest side. This can be done easily with the jetpack, or you can Chicken Glide off the water tower via the south Guard Tower. Climb up a blue and white climbing platform. Pry open the iron-bar door. Proceed through the hallway (there's a dynamite vending machine here), then climb around the corner of the building. Hop up and go over the fence. Smash the crate in the middle of this area, build the teleporter pad, then use it to get to the statue.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Cherry Tree Hills)
markers.description:
No requirements
Follow the winding sidewalk path to the top of the hill above the TV station.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Auburn)
markers.description:
No requirements
Smash the boulders at the base of this support pillar. Build a jumping platform to get to the top of the pillar.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Lady Liberty Island)
markers.description:
Rex Fury, Astronaut
Rex Fury and the Astronaut disguise must be unlocked in order to get to Lady Liberty Island. This statue has no other requirements.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Paradise Sands)
markers.description:
No requirements
Climb a blue pipe at the base of the Herbert Hotel. The statue is located on the roof of the covered entrance.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Fresco)
markers.description: No requirements

markers.title: Silver Statue (Bright Lights Plaza)
markers.description:
No requirements
Use the Detective Point to find a key.

markers.title: Silver Statue (Pagoda)
markers.description: No requirements

markers.title: Silver Statue (Heritage Bridge)
markers.description:
No requirements
Smash the left payphone in front of this tower to build a jumping platform. Grab the handles to climb up.

markers.title: Rescue Cat (Lady Liberty Island)
markers.description:
Rex Fury, Astronaut
Rex Fury and the Astronaut disguise must be unlocked in order to get to Lady Liberty Island.

markers.title: Boulder (Pagoda)
markers.description: Hop over the southeastern corner of the fence leading into the Pagoda. The boulder is tucked into the corner beneath a group of normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Festival Square)
markers.description: At the Hospital's parking lot, go to the southwestern corner. The boulder is in the grass on the west edge, beneath a group of normal gray boulders. There are two piles here, the one furthest from the tree has the boulder.

markers.title: Boulder (Downtown)
markers.description: On the north side of the park with the giant bull statue. From the northern edge, look west. It will be behind a tree, next to a group of normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Lego City Airport)
markers.description: Under the highway, behind the northern support pillar.

markers.title: Boulder (Uptown)
markers.description: Go down the stairs to the docks. On the eastern side, head to the grassy patch with trees in it. Go to the southern side of this, and find a group of normal grey boulders behind a tree.

markers.title: Boulder (Blackwell Bridge)
markers.description: Jump off the southeast side of the bridge lift. Swim to the nearest support pillar. The west side of it has a climbable ramp. The boulder is beneath a group of normal gray boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Fort Meadows)
markers.description: Blow up the silver boulders across the highway from the gas station. The boulder is beneath a group of normal grey boulders to your left after the fork.

markers.title: Boulder (Bluebell National Park)
markers.description: Up a hill from the path, beneath a group of normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Bluebell National Park)
markers.description: Bluebell Dam is cordoned off with chain-link fences. This boulder is just outside the southeastern-most fence, under some normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Apollo Island)
markers.description: On the small island southeast of Apollo Island proper. Beneath a group of normal grey boulders on the west side of the circular pit.

markers.title: Boulder (Albatross Island)
markers.description: Circle around to the southern side of the island. The boulder is on the beach, up against the cliffside.

markers.title: Boulder (Cherry Tree Hills)
markers.description: Follow the train tracks to this natural opening in the cave. The boulder is in plain sight on the western side.

markers.title: Boulder (Auburn)
markers.description: Underneath the Auburn Bay Bridge.

markers.title: Boulder (Auburn Bay Bridge)
markers.description: Start at the southern support pillar for the bridge at road level. Go to the western side of the pillar. Jump over the railing to land on the concrete base of the pillar. The boulder is on the western side of the south edge of the pillar itself.

markers.title: Boulder (Lady Liberty Island)
markers.description: Rex Fury must be unlocked to get to Lady Liberty Island. The boulder is on the right side of the southern steps leading up to the statue.

markers.title: Boulder (Paradise Sands)
markers.description: On the beach, beneath the dock that has the amusement park on it.

markers.title: Boulder (Fresco)
markers.description: Behind a tree in the park, against the wall toward the southern end. Beneath some normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Fresco)
markers.description: East of Fusileani Tower, beneath some normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Grand Canal)
markers.description: Take the north fork of the canal. The boulder is on the south wall, hidden beneath a group of normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Bright Lights Plaza)
markers.description: Just before the entrance to the Cross Town Tunnel are some toll booths. Southwest of the southernmost booth is a group of normal grey boulders outside the bank.

markers.title: Boulder (Crescent Park)
markers.description: On the northern beach, hop over the wooden fence. It's beneath a group of normal tan boulders.

markers.title: Boulder (Kings Court)
markers.description: In the park, east of the fountain. Hidden beneath a group of normal grey boulders.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Festival Square)
markers.description: On the roof of the first floor of the hospital. This area is visited during Chapter 10 - Back on the Case. There is a covered walkway joining the central and east wings of the hospital. The north side is visited during the mission, the south side (on the other side of the walkway) is where this activity is.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Kings Court)
markers.description: Just outside the north entrance of the theater, find the loose concrete pad. Use it to get onto the awning, then climb up the ladder. The electrical box is behind the large Comedy and Tragedy Mask sign.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Downtown)
markers.description:
Farmer
To the north of the building with all of the Color Swappers stands a pair of buildings. Between them is a loose concrete pad. Use it to get onto a ladder, then climb up. On the roof, head left to another small ladder, then jump up to the top of the sign. Chicken Glide across to the roof of the Lego City Bank. Once on the roof, go left, climb up the wall, then hop into the court. The electrical box is on the north wall.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Crescent Park)
markers.description: Immediately to your left when entering Crescent Park at this entrance from Bright Lights Plaza.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Uptown)
markers.description: On the western roof of the Lego City Museum. The easiest way to get there is from the top of the Art Museum (the same route is used in Chapter 10 - Back on the Case), or by using a Helicopter and the nearby Crash Pad.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Fort Meadows)
markers.description: In the corrugated metal-roof structure in the woods.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Bluebell National Park)
markers.description: Attached to a house near the western cliffs.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Apollo Island)
markers.description:
Jetpack, Farmer
On the north side of the Mission Control building is a blue climbing pad. Use the jetpack to get to the pad and climb up. Use the vaulting pole to get across, where you'll find a plant. Use the farmer to grow it, then climb it. Slide across the gap to the Vehicle Assemly Building. Wall-run around the corner, then wall-run two more times. You will now be holding on to a blue and gray pipe. Shimmy right, then wall-run two more times. Climb up on the right side, wall-run back to the left, climb up the wall, climb up the ramp, jump on the trampoline to get to another climbing wall. Finally, on the roof of the VAB, go left to find the electrical box.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Albatross Island)
markers.description:
Astronaut, Farmer or Jetpack, Robber
In the rear prison yard, get to sloped roof on the southwest side. This can be done easily with the jetpack, or you can Chicken Glide off the water tower via the south Guard Tower. Climb up a blue and white climbing platform. Pry open the iron-bar door. Proceed through the hallway (there's a dynamite vending machine here), then climb around the corner of the building. Hop up and go over the fence. The electrical box is on the fence to your left.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Cherry Tree Hills)
markers.description:
Firefighter, Farmer
On the roof of the large apartment complex on the west side of Lombard Street. Start from the house just north of this building. Use the Fireman to get into the back yard, go up to the deck on the 2nd story, use the grappling hook to get onto the roof. Chicken Glide from here across to the apartment complex. At the southern tip is the electrical box to enable the activity.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Auburn)
markers.description:
Farmer and Firefighter, or Jetpack
Without the jetpack, start at the Call-in Point on the south side of Auburn. Go left and use the Grapple Hook to pull down a ladder. Climb up, go right, climb up this ladder. On this roof, use the Clue spot to open the nearby shed. Grab the crate inside and bring it to the green pad, then build an RC car. Use this car to activate two red button pads inside the electrified fence. Activating both turns off the electricity, allowing you to jump up onto it. Once on top of the fence, go right toward the shipping containers with the climbing wall. Chicken Glide onto them, go right and drop down to the ground. To the northwest is a plant. Grow it and climb up. Up ahead, jump left across the gap. Destroy the blue barrle and build a jumping platform. Climb up the ladder, then proceed across the street. Use the Firefighter to put out the flames in your way. Once across, go right to find the electrical box that enables this Drill Thrill.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Lady Liberty Island)
markers.description:
Rex Fury, Astronaut
Rex Fury and the Astronaut disguise must be unlocked in order to get to Lady Liberty Island. Near the northernmost tip of the island is a flagpole. The electrical box is on the southern edge of it.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Paradise Sands)
markers.description: On the Amusement Park dock, on the southern annex just inside the entrace.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Fresco)
markers.description:
Farmer (or Jetpack)
Grow a nearby plant to get onto the awnings, then head left to a blue pipe (or use the Astronaut's jetpack). Climb up, then head left. Vault over three walls (and use the jetpack to jump from the Astro Crate to the flat roof to the west - then continue right to the tight-rope), continue past the Astro Crate, and outside of the wooden structure. Circle around to the left and continue across three jumping platforms. Climb up the ladder, balance across the blue beams, then take the tight-rope across to the right. The electrical panel is just below you as you get off.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Bright Lights Plaza)
markers.description:
Astronaut
Due west from the middle of the roundabout is a building with loose concrete at the entrance. Use it to get onto the awning, use the tightrope to the right to get across, then head left to the climbable wall on the side of Quentins. Climb up, follow the awning north, use the teleport pad, proceed to the left to a jumping platform. You'll land on another awning. Go right and climb up a blue pole. The electrical panel is to the right on this roof.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Pagoda)
markers.description:
Astronaut
Climb the Chan's Limo sign. This route follows the first part of the Free Run that also starts at the base of the sign. Once you slide down the rope and cross the street, climb the ladder in front of you and go right to a teleport pad. Use it to get to the roof, where this Drill Thrill is.

markers.title: Drill Thrill (Lego City Airport)
markers.description: On the roof of the southern side of the terminal.
on the roof

Inside the hangar marked '23'; use the Contruction Worker disguise to fix the electrical box outside.
To get to this flag, you must get here using jetpack and chicken glide, starting from the bridge.

From the roof of the large bank building, use the Chicken Glide activity to glide to the chicken float. Procede along tighropes to the front of the aligator float.
You'll get on the tower from near the flag on hangar

markers.description: Build a trampoline from the debris of a smashable pay phone in front of the shopping mall to reach some handholds on the roof

markers.description: paint three ice cream carts pink in city center.
